serialization_policy.event_fingerprint_deduplication: duplicate state/event fingerprints produce NO_CHANGE rather than duplicate work
serialization_policy.context_reuse: reuse fresh validated context and send only changed observations plus affected dependency closure by default
serialization_policy.whole_context_fallback: expand when closure is incomplete, high-risk semantics cross owners, DesignEpoch/source root changes, or full assurance requires it
serialization_policy.blind_review_accumulation: one missing independent review per material packet when needed; persist completed family results and do not rerun unchanged packet hashes
serialization_policy.retry_owner: single delayed event wake after cooldown and exact-state re-observation

due_obligations.interpretation: Freshness/assurance deadlines that may create work when due; they are not independent polling schedules.
due_obligations.engine_pipeline_health: freshness <=6h; wake on health change or deadline
due_obligations.branch_pr_hygiene: freshness <=6h when needed; wake on branch/PR change or deadline
due_obligations.public_research_scout: at least 12h between runs and only for new/expired material evidence when higher-priority work is absent
due_obligations.legacy_pending_work_reconciliation: freshness <=1 day; process changed receipts/pending identities first
due_obligations.protocol_simplification: at most once per Asia/Kolkata day and only with measured growth/duplication evidence
due_obligations.pipeline_simplification: when 90-day assurance window is due or measured evidence reopens it
due_obligations.successor_candidate_composition: whenever new admitted semantic work is ready; no separate clock wake-up

rule: Only Garden Coordinator is an active Garden scheduler. It wakes from state/completion/freshness events, deduplicates unchanged state, applies the event-driven delta policy, and carries no independent route/state authority. Former lanes are worker roles/due obligations with no independent schedule.
authority_boundary: Scheduling, context compression, materiality and Process Algebra conformance cannot mint protected authority, alter ProcessVersion semantics, admit delegation envelopes, or promote canon.
